title: Reclaim stale sessions
summary: Active work claims remain protected independently of silence, parking or process death. Steering acquire automatically releases holders only with ended_at or terminated_at set. Other holders require explicit --take-over --reason TEXT; process or presence observations never authorize takeover. The stale-session preview, sweep and custody check protect a keepalive for up to an hour without renewal, an open relay or broker wake attempt, and a pending acknowledgement within five minutes of a wake. The sweep records keepalive_held or wake_delivery_in_flight and preserves the recipient receipt. Terminal stamps allow leftover custody reclamation.
